transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Well, mostly I came in because I’m just... tired in a way that doesn’t really make sense. I mean, I can sleep fine, and I keep up with everything at work alright, but I still feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even really gets going.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or having little interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy?

Well, it's been going on for a lot longer than just a couple of weeks, honestly. For a long time now, there's just been this... gray, flat feeling most days. And yeah, I guess I have lost interest. Even things I used to really look forward to—like going fishing, tending to my tomatoes, or going to a church concert—they just feel like items on a checklist now instead of something I actually enjoy doing.
Can you tell me roughly how long you've been feeling this flat, low mood—has it been going on for two years or more, or is it more recent than that?

Yeah, it's definitely been two years or more. I can actually pinpoint it pretty well... it's been going on since I was pulled back into full operational leadership at work. That was right about two years and four months ago. So, yeah, it's been a while.
Have you noticed any recent weight changes, feeling unusually cold, dry skin, or constipation?

Well, I haven't really noticed being unusually cold, or having dry skin or constipation or anything like that. But as for my weight... yeah, there has been a change there. 

My appetite has just been off more days than not lately. I'll often just work straight through lunch without even noticing I missed it, and then I just kind of pick at my dinner when I get home. I'm definitely not trying to lose weight, but my wife actually pointed out the other day that my pants are fitting a lot looser on me. So I guess I am dropping a few pounds just from not eating much.
Over these past two years or so, have you noticed feelings of low self-worth, hopelessness, or excessive guilt about things?

No, I wouldn't say I feel hopeless or guilty about anything. And my self-worth is fine, I guess. I just feel flat and tired, but I don't really beat myself up over things or feel like everything is doomed. It's just that gray feeling I mentioned earlier.
During these past two years, has there been any stretch of two months or more when you felt like your normal self again, without that flat, low feeling?

No, not really. There hasn't been any break that long. I might have a good day here or there, maybe even a decent week, but it always comes back. I definitely haven't had a solid two months where I just felt like my old self again. It's pretty much been a constant thing since I took on that role.
Over these past two years, have you noticed ongoing trouble concentrating or making decisions, even on simple everyday matters?

No, I wouldn't say I've had trouble with that. I mean, my job takes a lot of focus, and I'm still managing it fine. I make decisions all day at work without any real issue. So, no, concentration and making decisions haven't been a problem for me.
